purpose: Govern pilot administrative intervention, audit visibility and bounded recovery without creating a parallel authority or canonical ledger.

canonMappings.claim: Administrative UI or role does not authorize consequential mutation; every mutation resolves through AuthorityEvaluator.
Operational recovery does not silently rewrite canonical history; it reconciles an existing request and retains source lineage.
Accepted admin and recovery requests are replay-safe; conflicting request-id reuse fails closed.
Audit views are explicitly non-authoritative and disclose source lineage and freshness/staleness.
SW1-09 adds an operational façade over existing canonical boundaries and does not introduce new canonical meanings.

productionBoundary: No production launch, live funds/provider activation, blanket administrator authority, or claim of complete distributed transaction fencing.
